# meok-cold-chain-pharma-mcp

> Pharmaceutical cold-chain + Good Distribution Practice compliance — MHRA WDA(H), EU/UK GDP 2013/C 343/01, WHO PQ, EU+UK FMD divergence, 2-8°C excursion detection, dry-ice DG, controlled-drugs, temperature-mapping qualification. For UK pharma wholesalers + 3PL + clinical-trial supply. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_gdp_compliance
- check_qualified_person_responsible
- check_temperature_excursion
- check_who_pq_compliance
- check_serialisation_falsified_medicines
- prepare_mhra_audit_pack
- check_dangerous_goods_pharma
- validate_temperature_mapping_qualification

## Install
```
pip install meok-cold-chain-pharma-mcp
```
